cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your rooftop wedding photo would look lovely. Try that staff-only door first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the bride. They'll notice me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. They'll forgive you. I'll follow once you've explained the dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll hold the very end, so if they object, only your train has followed you in.
